meta.host_policy: Every row is host-agnostic (no `has`): one rule set answers every hostname attached to the redirect project.
meta.slash_policy: Exact redirect rows whose source ends in '/' cover the slashless, slash, /index.html and /index.html/ forms (emitted as `<source-without-slash>{/index.html}?{/}?`); file rows match exactly.
meta.case_policy: Sources and destinations preserve slug case; matching is case-sensitive (routing-utils sourceToRegex sensitive:true).
meta.status: redirect-301 rows emit statusCode 301; http:// adds Vercel's HTTPS 308 first hop.
meta.header_policy: Every path gets the security headers. Rows of class "service-worker" also get Content-Type application/javascript and Cache-Control no-cache, so browsers always fetch the kill-switch on an update check; the class, not the path, selects these headers.
